info.title: SeatSure API
info.description: HTTP API of SeatSure. Every success response is `{ "success": true, "data": ... }`; every failure is `{ "success": false, "message": "<code>", "errors"?: [...] }`. Generated from the endpoint registry; do not edit by hand.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Sign in, refresh, sign out and the current user.

tags.name: Courses
tags.description: Course catalogue, creation, approval, updates and cancellation.

tags.name: Bookings

get.description:
Answers `{ ok: true }` when the API process is up. Does not check Supabase.

Public, no token needed.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description:
Returns a session. Send `accessToken` as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every other call, and use `refreshToken` with `POST /auth/refresh` when the access token expires. `expiresAt` is epoch seconds. Throttled sign-ins answer `429` instead of `401`.

Public, no token needed.

Errors (the `message` of the failure envelope):

- `400` `Validation failed`: The body or a parameter failed validation; `errors` lists each field.
- `401` `Invalid login credentials`: Wrong email or password.
- `429` `rate_limited`: Too many sign-in attempts; try again later.

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for a new session
post.description:
Returns a fresh session (a new access token and a new refresh token). The old refresh token should not be reused.

Public, no token needed.

Errors (the `message` of the failure envelope):

- `400` `Validation failed`: The body or a parameter failed validation; `errors` lists each field.
- `401` `not_authenticated`: The refresh token is invalid, expired or already used.
- `429` `rate_limited`: Refresh was throttled; try again later.

Ends this session on the server, so its access and refresh tokens stop working. Other devices stay signed in.

Requires a bearer token (any role).

Errors (the `message` of the failure envelope):

- `401` `not_authenticated`: Missing, malformed, expired or revoked bearer token.

get.description:
Returns the id, email, full name and role of the token owner.

Requires a bearer token (any role).

Errors (the `message` of the failure envelope):

- `401` `not_authenticated`: Missing, invalid or expired token, or the account has no profile.

What comes back depends on the caller. Query flags: `pending=true` (admin only) returns the approval queue, oldest first; `mine=true` limits the list to the caller's own courses.

- Parent: approved courses that are not cancelled (closed registration still shows, with `registration_open=false`). Pending, rejected and cancelled courses never appear.
- Teacher: their own courses whatever the approval status (pending, approved, rejected, cancelled). Asking for the pending queue is `forbidden`.
- Admin: every approved course, cancelled ones included. With `pending=true`, the courses waiting for review.

`seats_taken` counts paid bookings plus holds that have not run out; it is 0 for courses that are not approved. Oldest course first.

Requires a bearer token (any role).

Errors (the `message` of the failure envelope):

- `400` `Validation failed`: The body or query does not match the schema; `errors` lists the fields.
- `401` `not_authenticated`: Missing, invalid or expired access token.
- `403` `forbidden`: The role may not do this.

post.description:
Teachers only. The course is created for the caller with `approval_status=pending` and `registration_open=false`; it stays hidden from parents until admin01 approves it.

Title is trimmed and must not be empty, `capacity` is a whole number of at least 1, `price` is 0 or more, and `endsAt` must be after `startsAt` (ISO 8601 date-times).

Requires a bearer token with role: teacher.

Errors (the `message` of the failure envelope):

- `400` `Validation failed`: The body or query does not match the schema; `errors` lists the fields.
- `400` `invalid_course_schedule`: The schedule ends before it starts.
- `401` `not_authenticated`: Missing, invalid or expired access token.
- `403` `forbidden`: The role may not do this.

patch.description:
Send any of `capacity`, `registrationOpen`, or `startsAt` together with `endsAt`.

- Admin: `capacity` and `registrationOpen`. Changing the schedule is `forbidden`.
- Teacher: the schedule of their own course only. Another teacher's course, or any other field, is `forbidden`.
- Parent: `forbidden`.

Capacity cannot drop below the seats already taken (`capacity_below_booked`). A cancelled course cannot reopen registration (`course_cancelled`); closing it is allowed. Returns the updated course.

Requires a bearer token with role: teacher, admin.

Errors (the `message` of the failure envelope):

- `400` `Validation failed`: The body or query does not match the schema; `errors` lists the fields.
- `400` `capacity_below_booked`: The new capacity is lower than the seats already taken.
- `400` `course_cancelled`: Registration cannot be reopened on a cancelled course.
- `400` `invalid_course_schedule`: The schedule ends before it starts.
- `401` `not_authenticated`: Missing, invalid or expired access token.
- `403` `forbidden`: The role may not do this.
- `404` `course_not_found`: No course has this id (a malformed id counts as unknown).

post.summary: Approve or reject a submitted course
post.description:
Only the school admin account (`admin01@seatsure.test`) may review; other admins get `admin01_required`, other roles `forbidden`.

`approved=true` sets `approval_status=approved` and opens registration; `approved=false` sets `rejected` and keeps registration closed. Returns the updated course.

Requires a bearer token with role: admin.

Errors (the `message` of the failure envelope):

- `400` `Validation failed`: The body or query does not match the schema; `errors` lists the fields.
- `401` `not_authenticated`: Missing, invalid or expired access token.
- `403` `forbidden`: The role may not do this.
- `403` `admin01_required`: The caller is an admin but not the school admin account.
- `404` `course_not_found`: No course has this id (a malformed id counts as unknown).

post.summary: Cancel a course and report its refunds
post.description:
Admin role only. Closes registration, records the reason, cancels every held or paid booking, marks succeeded payments `refund_due` and writes one `refund_reports` row per paid booking.

`data` is the number of refunds reported. The reason is trimmed and required. A course can be cancelled once.

Requires a bearer token with role: admin.

Errors (the `message` of the failure envelope):

- `400` `Validation failed`: The body or query does not match the schema; `errors` lists the fields.
- `400` `cancellation_reason_required`: The reason is blank.
- `400` `course_already_cancelled`: The course was cancelled before.
- `401` `not_authenticated`: Missing, invalid or expired access token.
- `403` `forbidden`: The role may not do this.
- `404` `course_not_found`: No course has this id (a malformed id counts as unknown).

post.summary: Book a seat in a course
post.description:
Holds one seat for the named student, as the signed-in user, and answers `201` with the new booking (status `held`). The seat count is checked under a row lock, so concurrent requests for the last seat give exactly one booking and `course_full` to the rest. An account can have one held or paid booking per course: a second request (for example a double-click) answers `already_booked`. Holds that ran out are released first. A transfer booking stays held for 7 days until payment is confirmed. The student name is trimmed; an empty or blank `studentName` answers `student_name_required` (the server checks it before the schema's non-empty rule, so it is never a `Validation failed`).

Requires a bearer token (any role).

Errors (the `message` of the failure envelope):

- `400` `student_name_required`: The student name is empty or blank.
- `400` `Validation failed`: `courseId` is missing or not a uuid; see `errors`.
- `400` `course_full`: Every seat is paid or held.
- `400` `registration_closed`: The course does not accept bookings now.
- `400` `already_booked`: This account already holds or paid a seat in the course.
- `400` `course_not_approved`: The course is pending, rejected or cancelled.
- `401` `not_authenticated`: Missing, invalid or expired bearer token.
- `404` `course_not_found`

get.description:
The signed-in user's own bookings, newest first, each with the course title and price, its payments (receipts and `refund_due` entries) and its transfer proof. Every role sees only its own bookings here.

Requires a bearer token (any role).

Errors (the `message` of the failure envelope):

- `401` `not_authenticated`: Missing, invalid or expired bearer token.

get.summary: List held and paid bookings I can see
get.description:
Bookings with status `held` or `paid`, oldest first, without joins. A parent gets their own; a teacher gets their own plus the bookings of the courses they teach; an admin gets all. A `held` row whose `hold_expires_at` has passed no longer holds a seat: the client compares it with the current time (paid, or held and not yet expired, holds a seat). Used by the course cards ("already booked") and the teacher's student lists.

Requires a bearer token (any role).

Errors (the `message` of the failure envelope):

- `401` `not_authenticated`: Missing, invalid or expired bearer token.

One booking of the signed-in user with course, payments and transfer proof (the receipt page). Bookings of other accounts, unknown ids and malformed ids all answer `booking_not_found`, so the API does not reveal whether a booking exists.

Requires a bearer token (any role).

Errors (the `message` of the failure envelope):

- `401` `not_authenticated`: Missing, invalid or expired bearer token.
- `404` `booking_not_found`: No booking with this id belongs to you.

get.summary: List the students of a course
get.description:
Every booking of the course (any status), oldest first. Allowed for the course's teacher and for admins; another teacher gets `403 forbidden` and no data. Each viewer sees what the database policies allow them: the teacher gets the booking rows and student names only (`profiles.full_name` is `""`, `payments` and `payment_proofs` are empty); an admin also gets the parent's name and the payments; only the school admin (`admin01@seatsure.test`) also gets the transfer proofs, each with a `signed_url` to the private image valid for 600 seconds. For any other admin `payment_proofs` is empty.

Requires a bearer token with role: teacher, admin.

Errors (the `message` of the failure envelope):

- `401` `not_authenticated`: Missing, invalid or expired bearer token.
- `403` `forbidden`: Not an admin, and not the teacher of this course.
- `404` `course_not_found`

put.description:
The parent sends the transfer slip as the raw request body, with `Content-Type` set to exactly one of `image/jpeg`, `image/png` or `image/webp`. Not multipart, not JSON. The media type below reads `image/*` only because the spec lists one; other image types such as `image/gif` are rejected.

- Only the owner of the booking may upload, and only while the booking is `held`. The booking hold lasts 7 days from booking.
- The image is stored privately at `<user id>/<booking id>-<uuid>.<jpg|png|webp>`. Uploading does not pay: the booking stays `held` until `confirmPayment`.
- Uploading again replaces the earlier proof: the same proof record points at the new image and the old image is deleted, so a booking has at most one stored proof.
- If recording the proof fails after the image was stored, the image is deleted again.
- Any other content type is `proof_type_invalid` (HTTP 400). A body over 5 MiB (5,242,880 bytes) is `proof_size_exceeded` (HTTP 413). An empty body is `payment_proof_required`. Nothing is stored in these cases.

Requires a bearer token (any role).

Errors (the `message` of the failure envelope):

- `400` `proof_type_invalid`: The body is not `image/jpeg`, `image/png` or `image/webp`.
- `400` `payment_proof_required`: The body is empty.
- `400` `booking_not_payable`: The booking is not `held` (cancelled or expired; a paid booking takes no new proof).
- `400` `Validation failed`: The body or a parameter failed validation; `errors` lists each field.
- `401` `not_authenticated`: Missing, invalid or expired access token.
- `404` `booking_not_found`: No booking with this id belongs to the caller (someone else's booking and a malformed id count as unknown).
- `413` `proof_size_exceeded`: The body is larger than 5 MiB.

post.description:
The parent presses "confirm payment" after uploading a proof. No request body.

- Only the owner of the booking may confirm. The booking must be `held` and have a stored proof image.
- On success the booking becomes `paid` and exactly one payment is recorded for the course price, with a receipt number `RC-YYYYMMDD-nnnnnn`.
- Idempotent: confirming a booking that is already paid succeeds and charges nothing more, also when several confirms arrive at once.
- Card payment is retired; bank transfer with a proof is the only way to pay.

Requires a bearer token (any role).

Errors (the `message` of the failure envelope):

- `400` `booking_not_payable`: The booking is cancelled or expired.
- `400` `payment_proof_required`: No proof image has been uploaded for the booking.
- `401` `not_authenticated`: Missing, invalid or expired access token.
- `404` `booking_not_found`: No booking with this id belongs to the caller (someone else's booking and a malformed id count as unknown).

get.description:
Admin only. Returns every approved course, cancelled ones included, with its seat count (`courses`, oldest first) and every refund report (`refunds`, newest first).

A refund report is written when a course with paid bookings is cancelled; it names the account to refund and the receipt.

Requires a bearer token with role: admin.

Errors (the `message` of the failure envelope):

- `401` `not_authenticated`: Missing, invalid or expired access token.
- `403` `forbidden`: Only the admin may read payments.

Admin only. Every refund report, newest first. Each one is a paid booking of a cancelled course that must be refunded by bank transfer.

Requires a bearer token with role: admin.

Errors (the `message` of the failure envelope):

- `401` `not_authenticated`: Missing, invalid or expired access token.
- `403` `forbidden`: Only the admin may read payments.

Failure.description: Every error leaves the API in this envelope. `message` is the error code (or `Validation failed`).
